select bw_cargo.id, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.cargo_code, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification, bw_cargo_category.cargo_category_name, bw_cargo.unit_id, bw_cargo.enable from bw_cargo left join bw_cargo_category on bw_cargo.cargo_category_id = bw_cargo_category.id and bw_cargo_category.is_deleted = false where bw_cargo.is_deleted = false and bw_cargo_category.is_deleted = false
and bw_cargo.cargo_name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.cargoName}, '%')
and bw_cargo.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.mergeCode}, '%')
and bw_cargo.enable = #{pageQuery.enable}
and 1 = 2
and bw_cargo.cargo_category_id in
#{id}
order by bw_cargo.merge_code

select bw_cargo.id as business_id, bw_cargo.cargo_name, bw_cargo.cargo_code, bw_cargo.merge_code, bw_cargo.specification as cargo_specification from bw_cargo where bw_cargo.is_deleted = 0
and bw_cargo.id in
#{item}
and 1 = -1
